meta.description: Rayan Jain is a computer science engineering student at SPIT, Mumbai, and a former Barclays technology developer intern. Full-stack, DevOps and systems work, shown as a pixel-art world or a quick view.

profile.name: Rayan Jain
profile.title: Full-stack & DevOps developer
profile.tagline: CS engineering student at SPIT. Ex-Barclays intern. Ex-Tech Head at CSI-SPIT.
profile.bio: I'm a computer science engineering student at SPIT in Mumbai, a former technology developer intern at Barclays and, until July 2026, Technical Head of CSI-SPIT. I build full-stack products and the infrastructure under them: a Rust browser that shrugs off prompt injection, a developer platform that goes from "pick a stack" to a monitored Kubernetes deploy, and native Mac tools. I also do competitive programming.
profile.now: Shipping AIO, a native macOS launcher, Dock and notch suite, and EveryDaily, a tracker for daily puzzle games.
profile.motto: ship fast. break things. fix faster.

projects.title: Ferrite
projects.tagline: A browser for AI agents that can't be talked into things.
projects.description: A cross-platform browser written in Rust on the Servo engine, so an AI agent can browse without being steered by what it reads. Ferrite does not try to spot malicious text. It predicts what the task legitimately needs from the prompt, dry-runs the agent's plan in a no-network sandbox, compares the two, and gates any deviation behind a consent panel that pages cannot reach. It has tabs, find, zoom, bookmarks, history, downloads and built-in DevTools.
highlights: Predict, dry-run, compare, consent-gate defence against indirect prompt injection
Runtime guard, 8-language sanitizer and a SHA-256 hash-chained audit log
Over 3,968 live-model runs the guard cut executed attacks from 2.0% to 0.4%
OpenGL renderer with CPU fallback; fixed engine bugs in layout, WebGL swap and threading

projects.title: AIO
projects.tagline: A macOS launcher, Dock and notch suite in one native app.
projects.description: A native macOS launcher, Dock, notch island and desktop-widget suite. SwiftUI and AppKit draw everything you see, and a Rust engine, cortexd, handles search and memory over a local JSON-RPC socket. A shortcut acts on any selection with Ollama or any OpenAI-compatible server. Everything stays on the Mac, and screen memory is off until you turn it on.
highlights: Command palette over apps, files, clipboard, git, browser tabs and system commands
Dock with live window previews and widget tiles
Notch island with now playing and synced lyrics, a focus timer and a file shelf
Swift app plus Rust engine; CI builds and tests on every push

projects.title: DuckOps
projects.tagline: Pick a stack. Get a repo, a k8s deploy, CI/CD and monitoring.
projects.description: A self-hosted internal developer platform of six microservices that turns a prompt into a deployed, monitored app. Choose a stack in a wizard and DuckOps scaffolds the code, creates the GitHub repo, builds and pushes the image, provisions a Kubernetes namespace with Terraform, deploys with Ansible and wires a Jenkins pipeline, streaming every stage live over Socket.io.
highlights: 8-stage automated provisioning pipeline across 6 microservices
Terraform, Ansible and auto-created Jenkins pipelines on a local k3d cluster
BullMQ and Redis job queue, live Socket.io status, 30 s health checks, Prometheus and Grafana
An AI builder that commits and redeploys code

projects.title: Sentinel
projects.tagline: A system monitor and AI control center for macOS, Windows and Linux.
projects.description: A native macOS, Windows and Linux monitor for live processes, ports mapped to PIDs, CPU, memory and disk, plus a tool-calling AI agent whose actions need your approval. Under it sits an OS abstraction layer over /proc and netlink (Linux), sysctl and IOKit via FFI (macOS) and the Win32/NT APIs (Windows). Rust core with Tauri v2 and a React interface.
highlights: Every listening port and connection matched to its owning process
AI agent proposes each step; nothing runs without approval
Process control via POSIX signals, pidfd and scheduling priority
Samples under 2.1% CPU using multithreading, lock-free channels and ring buffers

projects.title: DevHub
projects.tagline: Postman, DevTools and Burp Suite in one workspace.
projects.description: A unified developer workspace in place of Postman, Chrome DevTools and Burp Suite: an HTTP, WebSocket and GraphQL client, a live network inspector, an intercepting proxy with repeater and intruder, decoder, comparer and sequencer, and a route scanner that reads a repo's AST. It ships as a web app, an Electron desktop app and a Chrome MV3 extension, with a workspace-aware Claude assistant.
highlights: Intercept, edit and replay in-flight requests
Intruder with 4 attack modes and response clustering
AST-based API route discovery from GitHub and GitLab repos

projects.title: NeuroCred
projects.tagline: A live digital twin and credit engine for Indian MSMEs.
projects.description: Builds a live, versioned digital twin of a small business from UPI, bank, SMS and EMI signals, then runs a credit engine on top of it: Monte Carlo risk simulation, anomaly and fraud detection on Redis Streams, and plain-language reasoning from a local LLM. Won 1st place at AIRAVAT '26 (SPIT) with Team Pookies.
highlights: Ten-tier async pipeline from ingestion to audit export
Monte Carlo risk projections and stress tests
Event-sourced twin that can be replayed to any point in time

projects.title: CreatorAi
projects.tagline: A local-first workspace for solo video creators.
projects.description: Plan an idea, write a script with AI, upload raw footage, and the app transcribes and indexes it, matches the script to the footage, cuts short clips and finishes them on an editable timeline before export. It runs on your own machine as a FastAPI API and a Next.js app over SQLite, with the AI provider of your choice (Gemini, Groq or Ollama). Anything that is not a real model result is labelled in the UI.
highlights: Hybrid semantic search over speech and visuals
Script-to-footage matching with a coverage report
Timeline editor with exports for Shorts, Reels and TikTok
No Docker, Redis or Postgres: SQLite and an in-process job runner

projects.title: EveryDaily
projects.tagline: Follow, play and track daily puzzle games in one place.
projects.description: A tracker for daily puzzle games with stats, streaks, reminders, friends and communities. A Next.js app on Vercel, a Cloudflare Worker for cron, queues and realtime rooms, and a shared package for the schema, validators and game registry. Sign-in uses passkeys, with Vitest unit tests and Playwright end-to-end tests.
highlights: Stats, streaks, reminders, friends and communities
Cloudflare Worker for cron, queues and realtime rooms
pnpm monorepo with a shared schema and game registry

projects.title: CreditIQ
projects.tagline: MSME credit scoring from GST, UPI and e-way bill signals.
projects.description: A credit scoring engine for Indian MSMEs built with a team. It fuses GST invoices, UPI transactions and e-way bills into a 300 to 900 score, finds circular-trading fraud rings with graph analysis, explains each score with SHAP attributions and plain-language LLM reasons, and presents it all in a React dashboard.
highlights: Winners, 1st Place @ Ignisa '26 MITWPU (team Brawn GP 1251)
46 engineered features over three Redis streams
Fraud rings found with strongly connected components and cycle enumeration
XGBoost scoring with SHAP explanations

projects.title: ClassroomPilot
projects.tagline: An MCP server that connects a student's own AI assistant to Google Classroom.
projects.description: A remote MCP server that reads a student's assignments, rubrics, announcements and attached files, prepares documents in LaTeX or Google Docs, fills the student's own template copy only after a preview-and-approve step, and hands over to the student for Turn In. It runs as a Cloudflare Worker with OAuth, plus a small file-picker page.
highlights: 25 tools across Classroom, files, documents and hand-off
Preview and approve before any edit; the student does the Turn In
Figures in documents are marked captured or illustrative

projects.title: Nebula
projects.tagline: Dynamic malware analysis with transformer networks.
projects.description: A full-stack platform that detects and explains malicious Windows software. Executables run under emulation, their API-call traces are tokenized and fed to a chunked transformer, explainable-AI attributions show what the model saw, and an LLM layer writes the threat-intel summary. A FastAPI backend serves a Next.js dashboard.
highlights: 95.4% accuracy and 0.989 AUC-ROC on a 3,181-sample validation set
Chunked transformer over emulated Windows API-call traces
Explainable attributions and LLM threat summaries

projects.title: Financial Research Automation
projects.tagline: SEC filings in, investor report out.
projects.description: An end-to-end pipeline that drives a live Chromium browser through real SEC EDGAR filings, extracts and normalizes the quarterly statements, computes ratios and peer benchmarks, and renders an investor-grade PowerPoint report. FastAPI serves the data, Streamlit shows it and Celery runs the slow jobs. There is no seeded or mocked financial data: a failed scrape fails loudly.
highlights: Playwright scrapes real 10-Q and 10-K filings from sec.gov
YoY, QoQ, margins, ROE and peer percentile from normalized line items
Fails loudly instead of substituting fake figures

projects.title: Vendex
projects.tagline: Reel to real: product video to ranked supplier list.
projects.description: Paste an Instagram or TikTok reel, or an Alibaba link, and Vendex returns a ranked supplier shortlist in about 60 seconds, with prices, MOQs, trust badges and one-click chat. Built during an internship at LazerBelieve: a concurrent vision and scraping pipeline (yt-dlp, OpenCV, patched Playwright) runs 10 parallel browser tabs per job with CAPTCHA solving, handles CSV batches over 2 concurrent jobs, and ships with a Chrome extension.
highlights: Product reel or URL to a ranked Alibaba supplier shortlist in about 60 s
10 parallel browser tabs per job with CAPTCHA solving
CSV batches over 2 concurrent jobs, plus a Chrome extension

projects.title: DAP
projects.tagline: Digital asset protection against sports piracy.
projects.description: A rights-management prototype for sports media: perceptual fingerprints and invisible CNN watermarks on ingest, scraping and Hamming-distance matching to find infringing copies, an enforcement priority score, and Gemini-drafted, jurisdiction-aware takedown notices.
highlights: pHash and dHash fingerprints, HiDDeN CNN watermarking
Enforcement Priority Score from 0 to 100
Auto-drafted DMCA, EU DSM and IT Act notices

projects.title: CtrlFixIt
projects.tagline: A real-time competitive coding game for live events.
projects.description: A competitive coding game platform built for live events, with live scoreboards over WebSockets, Docker-sandboxed code execution through Piston, single-session enforcement and server-authoritative timing. Next.js frontend, Node and Express backend on PostgreSQL, Redis and Prisma. Built during my year as CSI-SPIT Technical Head.
highlights: Built for 120+ simultaneous users at live events
Code runs in network-less Docker sandboxes via Piston
Piston configured for 150 concurrent jobs on a single host

projects.title: Wdraw
projects.tagline: A shared canvas where a room draws together in real time.
projects.description: A collaborative drawing app. People join a room by its link and sketch on the same canvas, with every stroke relayed live over WebSockets. Built as a Turborepo monorepo: a Next.js canvas front end, an Express HTTP service for accounts and rooms, a separate WebSocket server, and a shared Prisma database package, deployed to a VM by a GitHub Actions workflow.
highlights: Room-based canvases kept in sync over a dedicated WebSocket server
Monorepo split into front end, HTTP API, WS server and shared DB package
JWT auth with argon2 password hashing
Push-to-production deploy via GitHub Actions over SSH

projects.title: Chess
projects.tagline: Online multiplayer chess, matched and played over WebSockets.
projects.description: A browser chess game for two players. A small Node WebSocket server pairs waiting players into games, validates every move with chess.js on the server, and streams the board to both sides; the React front end renders the board and plays the moves it receives.
highlights: Server-side move validation with chess.js, so clients cannot cheat
Game manager that pairs waiting players into live matches
React and Vite front end with animated board

projects.title: StackIt
projects.tagline: A minimalist Q&A forum for learning together.
projects.description: A question-and-answer platform built for focused, structured knowledge sharing. Guests can read, signed-in users ask and answer with a rich text editor, vote, and tag questions, and the person who asked can accept the best answer. Admins moderate. Next.js front end on Radix UI, Express and MongoDB back end, Clerk for auth and Cloudinary for image uploads.
highlights: Guest, user and admin roles with moderation
Rich text questions and answers with images, voting and accepted answers
Tag-based filtering and search

projects.title: BUG//REPORT
projects.tagline: A 3D systemic puzzle game where you play the bug.
projects.description: A 3D systemic puzzle game in which you play the bug inside someone else's video game, built in Unity 6 with C# and URP. The repo carries a layered architecture with an entity and capability model, a glitch system design, milestones and a plain-language playtest guide. The core rules compile and test without the Unity editor.
highlights: Core rules tested headless with NUnit on the .NET 8 SDK
Unity assemblies type-checked against API stubs by a script
CC0 art fetched by script and verified by checksum

projects.title: BoomSuite
projects.tagline: Break Apple's volume ceiling, up to 4x louder.
projects.description: Two native apps: BoomPlayer for iOS, a local music player with a 4x gain stage, EQ presets and lock-screen controls, and BoomMac for macOS, a system-wide audio booster for any app that routes sound through a CoreAudio HAL pipeline with BlackHole.
highlights: AVAudioEngine gain stage with EQ presets
System-wide boost through CoreAudio HAL
iOS and macOS

projects.title: skrgrep
projects.tagline: A fast, multi-threaded grep, in Rust.
projects.description: A line-oriented search tool with a work-stealing thread pool, recursive traversal that skips .git, node_modules and target, and highlighted matches. Published through my own Homebrew tap with pre-built bottles for Apple Silicon and Intel.
highlights: Work-stealing parallel file search
brew install skrgrep
Pre-built bottles for Apple Silicon and Intel

projects.title: IP Sniffer
projects.tagline: A fast multithreaded port scanner for the terminal.
projects.description: A Rust command-line port scanner. It spreads a port range across native threads, shows a live progress bar with an ETA, and names common services (SSH, HTTP, Redis, Docker and others) on the ports it finds open. Target, thread count, timeout and port range are all flags.
highlights: Multithreaded scan across the full 1-65535 range
Live progress bar with ETA via indicatif
Service identification for open ports

projects.title: Poker
projects.tagline: Real-time multiplayer poker with a Rust backend.
projects.description: An online poker platform with a real-time Rust backend (Axum, Tokio, SQLx on PostgreSQL) and a Next.js 15 frontend, synchronising game state over WebSockets.
highlights: Axum and Tokio real-time game server
WebSocket state sync

experience.description: Worked on the CI/CD and delivery tooling a regulated bank's engineering teams build on.
highlights: Modernized a shared GitLab CI/CD component library, adding dynamic environments and runtime variables
Automated build, test and deploy stages of containerized services on Kubernetes with Helm charts
Built a pipeline analytics dashboard tracking run history and failures in a regulated financial environment

experience.description: Led the technical side of the CSI-SPIT student chapter. Event tooling from the year includes CtrlFixIt, a competitive coding game built for 120+ simultaneous users, and the contributors board for the Git & GitHub workshop.
highlights: CtrlFixIt: built for 120+ simultaneous users at live events
Git & GitHub workshop contributors board

highlights: Vendex (Next.js, FastAPI, Playwright): product reel or URL to a ranked Alibaba supplier shortlist in about 60 s, with CSV batches over 2 concurrent jobs and a Chrome extension
Concurrent vision and scraping pipeline (yt-dlp, OpenCV, patched Playwright) running 10 parallel browser tabs per job with CAPTCHA solving
